531	    def amend(self, order_id, lines):
532	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
533	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
534	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
535	        requested = []
536	        needed = {}
537	        for line in lines:
538	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
539	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
540	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
541	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
542	            requested.append((sku, quantity))
543	            needed[sku] = needed.get(sku, 0) + quantity
544	        data = self._read()
545	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
546	        if order is None:
547	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
548	        if order["status"] != "placed":
549	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be amended")
550	        # Paused products may stay in an order, shrink or disappear, but no new
551	        # paused SKU can be added and its merged total may never grow. Compare
552	        # current ordered quantities against the merged new list -- never
553	        # history or actual reservations.
554	        current = {}
555	        for line in order["lines"]:
556	            current[line["sku"]] = current.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
557	        products = data.get("products", {})
558	        items = []
559	        for sku, quantity in requested:
560	            product = products.get(sku)
561	            if product is None:
562	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
563	            if not self._is_enabled(product) and (
564	                sku not in current or needed[sku] > current[sku]
565	            ):
566	                raise ValueError("product is not available for sale: " + sku)
567	            items.append({"sku": sku, "quantity": quantity, "unit_price_cents": product["price_cents"], "subtotal_cents": quantity * product["price_cents"]})
568	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
569	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
570	        # New demand may use what is available plus what this order already
571	        # holds; orders without reservation records get no extra allowance.
572	        reservations = {}
573	        for sku, quantity in needed.items():
574	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
575	            if entry is None:
576	                continue
577	            if quantity > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"] + own.get(sku, 0):
578	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
579	            reservations[sku] = quantity
580	        # Validate everything before touching inventory, so a rejected amend
581	        # leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. Stock history sees
582	        # only the final net change per sku, never the temporary release and
583	        # re-reservation below.
584	        affected = sorted(sku for sku in set(own) | set(reservations) if inventory.get(sku) is not None)
585	        before_views = {sku: self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]) for sku in affected}
586	        for sku, quantity in own.items():
587	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
588	            if entry is not None:
589	                entry["reserved"] -= quantity
590	        if reservations:
591	            for sku, quantity in reservations.items():
592	                inventory[sku]["reserved"] += quantity
593	            data.setdefault("reservations", {})[order_id] = reservations
594	        else:
595	            data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
596	        for sku in affected:
597	            after = self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku])
598	            if after != before_views[sku]:
599	                self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "amend", order_id, before_views[sku], after)
600	        order["lines"] = items
601	        order["total_cents"] = sum(x["subtotal_cents"] for x in items)
602	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "amend", order, False)
603	        self._write(data)
604	        return order

606	    def reduce_order(self, order_id, lines):
607	        # Reduce a placed order while keeping the deal: surviving rows keep
608	        # their original relative order and per-row deal unit prices; for each
609	        # sku the reduction is taken from the LAST row backwards, zero rows are
610	        # removed and surviving duplicate rows are never merged. Subtotals are
611	        # recomputed at the preserved prices. Paused sales, catalog-less
612	        # products and insufficient stock never block a reduction; whole-order
613	        # cancellation still goes through cancel. The order's own reservation
614	        # for an involved managed product becomes min(old reservation, merged
615	        # remaining quantity) -- only the difference is released, total
616	        # reserved drops and availability rises by the same amount, on_hand,
617	        # other orders and uninvolved products never change. Missing inventory
618	        # or reservation records read as no reservation (never auto-managed or
619	        # topped up); a reservation driven to zero loses its attribution key.
620	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
621	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
622	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
623	        requested = {}
624	        for line in lines:
625	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
626	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
627	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
628	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
629	            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
630	        data = self._read()
631	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
632	        if order is None:
633	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
634	        if order["status"] != "placed":
635	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reduced")
636	        current = {}
637	        for line in order["lines"]:
638	            current[line["sku"]] = current.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
639	        remaining_total = {}
640	        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
641	            if sku not in current:
642	                raise ValueError("sku not in order: " + sku)
643	            if quantity > current[sku]:
644	                raise ValueError("reduced quantity exceeds ordered quantity: " + sku)
645	            remaining_total[sku] = current[sku] - quantity
646	        # Reducing every line away is a cancellation and is rejected here.
647	        if sum(current[sku] - requested.get(sku, 0) for sku in current) == 0:
648	            raise ValueError("cannot reduce the whole order; cancel it instead")
649	        # Take each sku's reduction from its last row first by walking the
650	        # rows backwards, then restore the original relative order. Deal unit
651	        # prices travel with their rows and subtotals are recomputed at them;
652	        # zero-quantity rows disappear and surviving duplicates stay split.
653	        deduct = dict(requested)
654	        survivors_reversed = []
655	        for line in reversed(order["lines"]):
656	            sku = line["sku"]
657	            removed = min(line["quantity"], deduct.get(sku, 0))
658	            deduct[sku] = deduct.get(sku, 0) - removed
659	            quantity = line["quantity"] - removed
660	            if quantity:
661	                unit_price = line["unit_price_cents"]
662	                survivors_reversed.append({
663	                    "sku": sku,
664	                    "quantity": quantity,
665	                    "unit_price_cents": unit_price,
666	                    "subtotal_cents": quantity * unit_price,
667	                })
668	        items = list(reversed(survivors_reversed))
669	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
670	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
671	        # Plan every reservation change before mutating inventory, so a
672	        # rejection leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. Only
673	        # managed products hold reservations; a missing inventory record reads
674	        # as no reservation even if a stray attribution key exists.
675	        plan = []
676	        for sku in requested:
677	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
678	            if entry is None:
679	                continue
680	            old = own.get(sku, 0)
681	            new = min(old, remaining_total[sku])
682	            if new != old:
683	                plan.append((sku, old, new))
684	        before_views = {sku: self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]) for sku, _, _ in plan}
685	        record = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id)
686	        for sku, old, new in sorted(plan):
687	            inventory[sku]["reserved"] -= old - new
688	            if new:
689	                record[sku] = new
690	            else:
691	                record.pop(sku, None)
692	            self._record_stock_event(
693	                data, sku, "reduce-order", order_id,
694	                before_views[sku], self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]),
695	            )
696	        if record is not None and not record:
697	            # The order held no other reservations: drop its attribution.
698	            data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
699	        order["lines"] = items
700	        order["total_cents"] = sum(x["subtotal_cents"] for x in items)
701	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reduce-order", order, False)
702	        self._write(data)
703	        return order

705	    def reserve_order(self, order_id):
706	        # Top up reservations for a placed order whose products became managed
707	        # after it was placed. Deal lines, prices, amounts and status are never
708	        # touched, and paused sales never block the top-up.
709	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
710	        data = self._read()
711	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
712	        if order is None:
713	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
714	        if order["status"] != "placed":
715	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved")
716	        needed = {}
717	        for line in order["lines"]:
718	            needed[line["sku"]] = needed.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
719	        products = data.get("products", {})
720	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
721	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
722	        # Validate every sku and compute every addition against the current
723	        # availability before touching any inventory entry, so a rejected
724	        # top-up leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. A missing
725	        # reservation record reads as zero.
726	        additions = {}
727	        for sku in sorted(needed):
728	            if sku not in products:
729	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
730	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
731	            if entry is None:
732	                # Unmanaged products stay unlimited and are never auto-managed.
733	                continue
734	            added = max(0, needed[sku] - own.get(sku, 0))
735	            if added > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]:
736	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
737	            if added:
738	                additions[sku] = added
739	        lines = []
740	        for sku in sorted(needed):
741	            if inventory.get(sku) is None:
742	                lines.append({"sku": sku, "quantity": needed[sku], "added": 0, "reserved": 0})
743	            else:
744	                added = additions.get(sku, 0)
745	                lines.append({
746	                    "sku": sku,
747	                    "quantity": needed[sku],
748	                    "added": added,
749	                    "reserved": own.get(sku, 0) + added,
750	                })
751	        result = {"order_id": order_id, "lines": lines}
752	        if not additions:
753	            # Nothing to add: the result is still returned, but no file is
754	            # written and no events are appended.
755	            return result
756	        for sku in sorted(additions):
757	            entry = inventory[sku]
758	            before = self._stock_view(sku, entry)
759	            entry["reserved"] += additions[sku]
760	            self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "reserve-order", order_id, before, self._stock_view(sku, entry))
761	        reservations = data.setdefault("reservations", {}).setdefault(order_id, {})
762	        for sku, added in additions.items():
763	            reservations[sku] = reservations.get(sku, 0) + added
764	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reserve-order", result, False)
765	        self._write(data)
766	        return result

768	    def reserve_batch(self, order_ids):
769	        # Priority batch top-up: orders are processed in the given order
770	        # (input order is the priority); each order either gets its full new
771	        # demand or is skipped whole and consumes nothing, and later orders
772	        # keep being processed. The whole request is validated before any
773	        # mutation, so a rejected batch leaves data, history and sequences
774	        # untouched and never creates the data directory.
775	        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
776	            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
777	        selected = []
778	        seen = set()
779	        for order_id in order_ids:
780	            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
781	            if order_id in seen:
782	                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
783	            seen.add(order_id)
784	            selected.append(order_id)
785	        data = self._read()
786	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
787	        products = data.get("products", {})
788	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
789	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
790	        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole request
791	        # is rejected if any selected order is missing, no longer placed, or
792	        # carries a product outside the current catalog.
793	        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
794	        for order_id in selected:
795	            order = orders.get(order_id)
796	            if order is None:
797	                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
798	            if order["status"] != "placed":
799	                raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved: " + order_id)
800	            per_order = {}
801	            for line in order["lines"]:
802	                per_order[line["sku"]] = per_order.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
803	            for sku in per_order:
804	                if sku not in products:
805	                    raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
806	            demanded[order_id] = per_order
807	        # Plan against the shared margin (available after every existing
808	        # reservation, including orders outside the batch) without touching
809	        # data: a fitting order consumes margin, a skipped one consumes
810	        # nothing. Existing reservations are never released or transferred.
811	        remaining = {sku: entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"] for sku, entry in inventory.items()}
812	        plans = []  # (order_id, fits, needs, additions, available at turn)
813	        for order_id in selected:
814	            per_order = demanded[order_id]
815	            own = all_reservations.get(order_id, {})

875	    def transfer_reservation(self, source_id, target_id, lines):
876	        # Move reservations between two placed orders: the source gives up
877	        # quantities it actually holds and the target receives them, never
878	        # touching on_hand, total reserved, availability, other orders, status,
879	        # deal lines, prices or amounts. Paused sales never block a transfer.
880	        source_id = text(source_id, "source_id")
881	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")
882	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
883	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
884	        requested = {}
885	        for line in lines:
886	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
887	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
888	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
889	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
890	            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
891	        data = self._read()
892	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
893	        source = orders.get(source_id)
894	        if source is None:
895	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
896	        target = orders.get(target_id)
897	        if target is None:
898	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
899	        if source["status"] != "placed":
900	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can transfer a reservation: " + source_id)
901	        if target["status"] != "placed":
902	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a reservation: " + target_id)
903	        if source_id == target_id:
904	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")
905	        products = data.get("products", {})
906	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
907	        source_ordered = {}
908	        for line in source["lines"]:
909	            source_ordered[line["sku"]] = source_ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
910	        target_ordered = {}
911	        for line in target["lines"]:
912	            target_ordered[line["sku"]] = target_ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
913	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
914	        source_held = all_reservations.get(source_id, {})
915	        target_held = all_reservations.get(target_id, {})
916	        # Validate every sku against catalog, managed stock, both orders' lines
917	        # and both current balances before touching any record, so a rejected
918	        # transfer leaves reservations and history untouched.
919	        for sku in sorted(requested):
920	            if sku not in products:
921	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
922	            if sku not in inventory:
923	                raise ValueError("product is not managed: " + sku)
924	            if sku not in source_ordered or sku not in target_ordered:
925	                raise ValueError("sku must appear in both orders: " + sku)
926	        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
927	            if quantity > source_held.get(sku, 0):
928	                raise ValueError("source reservation is insufficient: " + sku)
929	            if target_held.get(sku, 0) + quantity > target_ordered[sku]:
930	                raise ValueError("target reservation would exceed ordered quantity: " + sku)

932	        # reserved per sku is unchanged, so no stock history is recorded.
933	        records = data.setdefault("reservations", {})
934	        source_record = records.setdefault(source_id, {})
935	        target_record = records.setdefault(target_id, {})
936	        result_lines = []
937	        for sku in sorted(requested):
938	            quantity = requested[sku]
939	            source_after = source_record.get(sku, 0) - quantity
940	            target_after = target_record.get(sku, 0) + quantity
941	            if source_after:
942	                source_record[sku] = source_after
943	            else:
944	                source_record.pop(sku, None)
945	            target_record[sku] = target_after
946	            result_lines.append({
947	                "sku": sku,
948	                "quantity": quantity,
949	                "source_reserved": source_after,
950	                "target_reserved": target_after,
951	            })
952	        if not source_record:
953	            records.pop(source_id, None)
954	        result = {"source_id": source_id, "target_id": target_id, "lines": result_lines}
955	        # Both orders keep the same full snapshot; each continues its own
956	        # sequence and legacy orders start at 1 with complete=False.
957	        self._record_event(data, source_id, "transfer-reservation", result, False)
958	        self._record_event(data, target_id, "transfer-reservation", result, False)
959	        self._write(data)
960	        return result

1039	        # preserved, never repriced against the catalog) and totals the two
1040	        # original amounts. Repricing, paused sales or a missing catalog entry
1041	        # never block a merge, and zero-price lines are kept. Per sku the
1042	        # source's actual reservations move to the target and the source's
1043	        # attribution is removed: on_hand, total reserved, availability and
1044	        # every other order's reservations never change, shortfalls are never
1045	        # topped up, unmanaged products are never auto-managed and read as
1046	        # zero reservation, and missing inventory/reservation collections or a
1047	        # missing own attribution read as empty. Everything is validated
1048	        # before any mutation, so a rejected merge leaves the file, sequences
1049	        # and every record untouched and never creates the data directory.
1050	        source_id = text(source_id, "source_id")
1051	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")
1052	        data = self._read()
1053	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
1054	        source = orders.get(source_id)
1055	        if source is None:
1056	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
1057	        target = orders.get(target_id)
1058	        if target is None:
1059	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
1060	        if source["status"] != "placed":
1061	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be merged away: " + source_id)
1062	        if target["status"] != "placed":
1063	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a merge: " + target_id)
1064	        if source_id == target_id:
1065	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")
1066	        # Every stored deal price on both orders must be a nonnegative integer
1067	        # (booleans rejected), and one sku's rows must agree on a single deal
1068	        # price across the merged lines -- the catalog price is never
1069	        # consulted and no row is picked as a substitute.
1070	        merged_prices = {}
1071	        for order in (source, target):
1072	            for line in order["lines"]:
1073	                sku = line["sku"]
1074	                unit_price = line.get("unit_price_cents")
1075	                if type(unit_price) is not int or unit_price < 0:

1092	        if moved:
1093	            target_record = data.setdefault("reservations", {}).setdefault(target_id, {})
1094	            for sku, quantity in moved.items():
1095	                target_record[sku] = target_record.get(sku, 0) + quantity

1887	    def reservation_plan(self, order_ids):
1888	        # Read-only priority preview of reservation top-ups: orders are previewed
1889	        # in the given order; an order whose new demand fits the remaining margin
1890	        # consumes that margin, a short order consumes nothing and later orders
1891	        # keep being evaluated. Existing reservations are never released or
1892	        # transferred; this never writes.
1893	        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
1894	            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
1895	        selected = []
1896	        seen = set()
1897	        for order_id in order_ids:
1898	            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
1899	            if order_id in seen:
1900	                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
1901	            seen.add(order_id)
1902	            selected.append(order_id)
1903	        data = self._read()
1904	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
1905	        products = data.get("products", {})
1906	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
1907	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
1908	        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole query is
1909	        # rejected if any selected order is missing, no longer placed, or carries
1910	        # a product outside the current catalog.
1911	        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
1912	        for order_id in selected:
1913	            order = orders.get(order_id)
1914	            if order is None:
1915	                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
1916	            if order["status"] != "placed":
1917	                raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved: " + order_id)
1918	            per_order = {}
1919	            for line in order["lines"]:
1920	                per_order[line["sku"]] = per_order.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
1921	            for sku in per_order:
1922	                if sku not in products:
1923	                    raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
1924	            demanded[order_id] = per_order
1925	        # The margin starts at stock's current available per managed sku and is
1926	        # only reduced by earlier orders that could be completed.
1927	        remaining = {}
1928	        for sku, entry in inventory.items():
1929	            remaining[sku] = entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]
1930	        results = []
1931	        for order_id in selected:
1932	            per_order = demanded[order_id]
1933	            own = all_reservations.get(order_id, {})
1934	            needs = {sku: max(0, qty - own.get(sku, 0)) for sku, qty in per_order.items()}
1935	            # Evaluate every managed sku before consuming anything: an order
1936	            # either covers all of its new demand or none of it.
1937	            fits = True
1938	            for sku in sorted(per_order):
1939	                if sku in inventory and needs[sku] > remaining.get(sku, 0):
1940	                    fits = False
1941	                    break
1942	            lines = []
1943	            for sku in sorted(per_order):
1944	                quantity = per_order[sku]
1945	                reserved = own.get(sku, 0)
1946	                demand = needs[sku]
1947	                if sku not in inventory:
1948	                    # Unmanaged products (including legacy data without inventory
1949	                    # records) never constrain demand and never consume margin.
1950	                    lines.append({
1951	                        "sku": sku,
1952	                        "quantity": quantity,
1953	                        "reserved": 0,
1954	                        "available": None,
1955	                        "shortfall": 0,
1956	                    })
1957	                    continue
1958	                available = remaining.get(sku, 0)
1959	                if fits:
1960	                    shortfall = 0
1961	                else:
1962	                    shortfall = max(0, demand - available)
1963	                lines.append({
1964	                    "sku": sku,
1965	                    "quantity": quantity,
1966	                    "reserved": reserved,
1967	                    "available": available,
1968	                    "shortfall": shortfall,
1969	                })
1970	            if fits:
1971	                for sku in per_order:
1972	                    if sku in inventory:
1973	                        remaining[sku] = remaining.get(sku, 0) - needs[sku]
1974	            results.append({
1975	                "order_id": order_id,
1976	                "can_reserve": fits,
1977	                "lines": lines,
1978	            })

1998	            if order["status"] != "placed":

2222	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")

2226	    def amend_return(self, return_id, expected_lines, lines):

2228	        # keeps its return_id and order, but its lines are replaced wholesale
2229	        # once the expected original content matches the current record. The
2230	        # new list may grow, shrink, drop or add skus as long as every sku
2231	        # belongs to the original order; paused sales, unmanaged stock and a
2232	        # missing catalog entry never block original-order products. The
2233	        # merged ordered quantity is the cap: the new quantity plus every
2234	        # other active registration of the same order (received ones included)
2235	        # must not exceed it, while this registration's old content and
2236	        # cancelled registrations occupy no allowance.
2237	        return_id = text(return_id, "return_id")
2238	        expected, _ = self._merged_return_lines(expected_lines, "expected_lines")
2239	        requested, after = self._merged_return_lines(lines, "lines")
2240	        data = self._read()
2241	        located = self._find_return(data, return_id)

    def cancel_batch(self, order_ids):
        # All-or-nothing batch cancel: every id is normalized and every order
        # is checked before any mutation, so a rejected batch leaves orders,
        # stock, reservations, history and sequences byte-for-byte untouched
        # and never creates the data directory.
        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")

        seen = set()
        for order_id in order_ids:

        orders = data.get("orders", {})

    def reopen_order(self, order_id):
        # Reopen a cancelled order under its original id: the deal (line order
        # and duplicate lines, quantities, deal prices, subtotals and total) is
        # preserved exactly and never repriced against the current catalog,
        # while every product is re-validated against the current catalog and
        # stock. Managed products reserve their full merged demand against the
        # availability left after every existing reservation -- never borrowing
        # other orders' reservations or any pre-cancel allowance; unmanaged
        # products stay unlimited, are never auto-managed and hold no
        # reservation. Everything is validated before any mutation, so a
        # rejected reopen leaves the file, reservations, history and sequences
        # untouched and never creates the data directory.
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] != "cancelled":
            raise ValueError("only a cancelled order can be reopened")
        needed = {}
        for line in order["lines"]:
            needed[line["sku"]] = needed.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
        products = data.get("products", {})
        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
        # Validate every sku against the current catalog and every managed
        # demand against the current availability before touching anything.
        for sku in sorted(needed):
            product = products.get(sku)
            if product is None:
                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
            if not self._is_enabled(product):
                raise ValueError("product is not available for sale: " + sku)
            entry = inventory.get(sku)
            if entry is not None and needed[sku] > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]:
                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
        reservations = {sku: needed[sku] for sku in needed if sku in inventory}
        if reservations:
            for sku in sorted(reservations):
                entry = inventory[sku]
                before = self._stock_view(sku, entry)
                entry["reserved"] += reservations[sku]
                self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "reopen-order", order_id, before, self._stock_view(sku, entry))
            data.setdefault("reservations", {})[order_id] = reservations
        order["status"] = "placed"
        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reopen-order", order, False)
        self._write(data)
        return order

    def _ship_order(self, data, order, carrier, tracking_no):
        # Shared mutation for ship and ship_batch: the caller has already
        # validated that the order is placed. Deducts only this order's actual
        # reservations, marks it shipped and appends the ship event; the caller
        # is responsible for writing `data`.
        order_id = order["order_id"]
        reservations = data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
        if reservations:
            inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
            for sku in sorted(reservations):
                entry = inventory.get(sku)
                if entry is not None:
                    before = self._stock_view(sku, entry)
                    entry["on_hand"] -= reservations[sku]
                    entry["reserved"] -= reservations[sku]
                    self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "ship", order_id, before, self._stock_view(sku, entry))
        order["status"] = "shipped"
        order["shipment"] = {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no}
        self._record_event(data, order_id, "ship", order, False)

    def ship(self, order_id, carrier, tracking_no):
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        carrier = text(carrier, "carrier")
        tracking_no = text(tracking_no, "tracking_no")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] == "cancelled":
            raise ValueError("a cancelled order cannot be shipped")
        if order["status"] == "shipped":
            raise ValueError("order already shipped")
        if order["status"] != "placed":
            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be shipped")
        self._ship_order(data, order, carrier, tracking_no)
        self._write(data)
        return order

    def ship_batch(self, shipments):
        # All-or-nothing batch shipment: every entry is normalized and every
        # referenced order is checked before any mutation, so a rejected batch
        # leaves orders, stock, reservations and history byte-for-byte untouched
        # and never creates the data directory.
        if not isinstance(shipments, list) or not shipments:
            raise ValueError("shipments must be a nonempty list")
        entries = []
        seen = set()
        for item in shipments:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                raise ValueError("each shipment must be an object with order_id, carrier and tracking_no")
            order_id = text(item.get("order_id"), "order_id")
            carrier = text(item.get("carrier"), "carrier")
            tracking_no = text(item.get("tracking_no"), "tracking_no")
            if order_id in seen:
                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
            seen.add(order_id)
            entries.append((order_id, carrier, tracking_no))
        data = self._read()
        orders = data.get("orders", {})
        planned = []
        for order_id, carrier, tracking_no in entries:
            order = orders.get(order_id)
            if order is None:
                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
            if order["status"] != "placed":
                raise ValueError("only a placed order can be shipped: " + order_id)
            planned.append((order, carrier, tracking_no))
        for order, carrier, tracking_no in planned:
            self._ship_order(data, order, carrier, tracking_no)
        self._write(data)
        return sorted((order for order, _, _ in planned), key=lambda x: x["order_id"])

    @staticmethod
    def _shipment_info(value, label):
        # Normalizes a shipment object: it must be an object whose carrier and
        # tracking_no are nonempty strings after trimming; extra fields are
        # ignored. Used for both the supplied info and the stored shipment.
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError(label + " must be an object with carrier and tracking_no")
        carrier = text(value.get("carrier"), "carrier")
        tracking_no = text(value.get("tracking_no"), "tracking_no")
        return {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no}

    def correct_shipment(self, order_id, expected_shipment, shipment):
        # Correct a recorded shipment after checking the original info: only
        # shipped or delivered orders qualify, existing returns never block it,
        # and both carrier and tracking_no must match the current shipment
        # before anything is replaced. Either field may change on its own;
        # tracking numbers are never checked for uniqueness across orders.
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        expected = self._shipment_info(expected_shipment, "expected_shipment")
        target = self._shipment_info(shipment, "shipment")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
            raise ValueError("only a shipped or delivered order can have its shipment corrected")
        # A missing or textually invalid stored shipment cannot be matched and
        # is never silently overwritten.
        current = self._shipment_info(order.get("shipment"), "shipment")
        if expected != current:
            raise ValueError("expected shipment does not match current shipment")
        result = {"order_id": order_id, "before": dict(current), "after": dict(target)}
        if target == current:
            # Original info matches but the target changes nothing: still
            # return the result, but no file is written and no event is
            # appended.
            return result
        order["shipment"] = {"carrier": target["carrier"], "tracking_no": target["tracking_no"]}
        self._record_event(data, order_id, "correct-shipment", result, False)
        self._write(data)
        return result

    def confirm_delivery(self, order_id, recipient, delivered_on):
        # Offline sign-off: a shipped order becomes delivered using a date the
        # caller provides (the system clock is never read). It never touches
        # lines, amounts, shipment, stock, reservations, existing returns or
        # stock history; only a recipient/delivered_on delivery object is added
        # and one confirm-delivery event is appended.
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        recipient = text(recipient, "recipient")
        delivered_on = calendar_date(delivered_on, "delivered_on")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] == "delivered":
            raise ValueError("order already delivered")
        if order["status"] != "shipped":
            raise ValueError("only a shipped order can be delivered")
        order["status"] = "delivered"
        order["delivery"] = {"recipient": recipient, "delivered_on": delivered_on}
        self._record_event(data, order_id, "confirm-delivery", order, False)
        self._write(data)
        return order

    def confirm_shipment_delivery(self, carrier, tracking_no, recipient, delivered_on):
        # Bulk offline sign-off: every order currently shipped under one
        # carrier + tracking number combination becomes delivered at once,
        # using a caller-provided date (the system clock is never read). The
        # matching rule is shipment_orders': only the order's current shipment
        # object counts, never historical ship/correct-shipment snapshots, and
        # only shipped or delivered orders qualify. A matched order already
        # delivered with the same normalized recipient and delivered_on keeps
        # its record untouched; one whose stored delivery disagrees -- or is
        # not an object, misses fields or carries invalid text/date -- rejects
        # the whole request before anything is signed. Lines, amounts,
        # shipment, stock, reservations, carts and existing returns are never
        # touched, returns never block signing, and no stock events are added.
        carrier = text(carrier, "carrier")
        tracking_no = text(tracking_no, "tracking_no")
        recipient = text(recipient, "recipient")
        delivered_on = calendar_date(delivered_on, "delivered_on")
        data = self._read()
        matched = []
        for order in data.get("orders", {}).values():
            if order.get("status") not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
                continue
            shipment = order.get("shipment")
            # A missing or non-object shipment, or one whose required fields
            # are missing, non-string or blank, simply cannot match.
            if not isinstance(shipment, dict):
                continue
            current_carrier = shipment.get("carrier")
            current_tracking = shipment.get("tracking_no")
            if not isinstance(current_carrier, str) or not isinstance(current_tracking, str):
                continue
            if current_carrier.strip() != carrier or current_tracking.strip() != tracking_no:
                continue
            matched.append(order)
        if not matched:
            raise ValueError("no orders match this shipment")
        matched.sort(key=lambda order: order["order_id"])
        # Check every already-delivered match against the request before
        # mutating anything, so a conflicting or malformed stored delivery
        # leaves the file, sequences and every other order untouched.
        pending = []
        for order in matched:
            if order["status"] != "delivered":
                pending.append(order)
                continue
            delivery = order.get("delivery")
            if not isinstance(delivery, dict):
                raise ValueError("stored delivery must be an object with recipient and delivered_on")
            if (text(delivery.get("recipient"), "recipient") != recipient
                    or calendar_date(delivery.get("delivered_on"), "delivered_on") != delivered_on):
                raise ValueError("stored delivery does not match the request: " + order["order_id"])
        if pending:
            # Mixed state: only the not-yet-delivered orders are signed; when
            # every match was already signed with the same info the result is
            # still returned but no file is written and no event is appended.
            for order in pending:
                order["status"] = "delivered"
                order["delivery"] = {"recipient": recipient, "delivered_on": delivered_on}
                self._record_event(data, order["order_id"], "confirm-delivery", order, False)
            self._write(data)
        return {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no, "orders": matched}

    @staticmethod
    def _delivery_info(value, label):
        # Normalizes a delivery object: it must be an object whose recipient
        # is a nonempty trimmed string and whose delivered_on is a real
        # YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; extra fields are ignored. Used for both
        # the supplied delivery and the stored delivery.
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError(label + " must be an object with recipient and delivered_on")
        recipient = text(value.get("recipient"), "recipient")
        delivered_on = calendar_date(value.get("delivered_on"), "delivered_on")
        return {"recipient": recipient, "delivered_on": delivered_on}

    def correct_shipment_delivery(self, carrier, tracking_no, expected_delivery, delivery):
        # Bulk correction of recorded sign-offs for one carrier + tracking
        # number combination: only orders currently delivered under it
        # qualify (shipped matches are not selected), and the expected
        # delivery's normalized recipient/delivered_on must match every
        # selected order's current delivery before anything is replaced.
        # Either field may change on its own; matching uses only the order's
        # current shipment object, never historical snapshots. Status, lines,
        # amounts, shipment, stock, reservations, carts and existing returns
        # are never touched, returns never block a correction, and no stock
        # events are added.
        carrier = text(carrier, "carrier")
        tracking_no = text(tracking_no, "tracking_no")
        expected = self._delivery_info(expected_delivery, "expected_delivery")
        target = self._delivery_info(delivery, "delivery")
        data = self._read()
        matched = []
        for order in data.get("orders", {}).values():
            # Only delivered orders are selected; shipped and every other
            # status never are, even when their shipment matches.
            if order.get("status") != "delivered":
                continue
            shipment = order.get("shipment")
            # A missing or non-object shipment, or one whose required fields
            # are missing, non-string or blank, simply cannot match.
            if not isinstance(shipment, dict):
                continue
            current_carrier = shipment.get("carrier")
            current_tracking = shipment.get("tracking_no")
            if not isinstance(current_carrier, str) or not isinstance(current_tracking, str):
                continue
            if current_carrier.strip() != carrier or current_tracking.strip() != tracking_no:
                continue
            matched.append(order)
        if not matched:
            raise ValueError("no delivered orders match this shipment")
        matched.sort(key=lambda order: order["order_id"])
        # Check every selected order's current delivery against the expected
        # delivery before mutating anything, so a conflicting or malformed
        # stored delivery leaves the file, sequences and every order
        # untouched. The original is always checked first, even when the
        # target equals the current delivery.
        for order in matched:
            current = self._delivery_info(order.get("delivery"), "delivery")
            if expected != current:
                raise ValueError("expected delivery does not match current delivery: " + order["order_id"])
        if target == expected:
            # Original info matched on every selected order but the target
            # changes nothing: still return the full result, but no file is
            # written and no event is appended.
            return {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no, "orders": matched}
        for order in matched:
            order["delivery"] = {"recipient": target["recipient"], "delivered_on": target["delivered_on"]}
            self._record_event(data, order["order_id"], "correct-delivery", order, False)
        self._write(data)
        return {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no, "orders": matched}

    def revoke_shipment_delivery(self, carrier, tracking_no, expected_delivery):
        # Bulk revoke of recorded sign-offs for one carrier + tracking number
        # combination: every order currently delivered under it becomes
        # shipped again (waiting for sign-off), its delivery field is removed,
        # and the shipment is kept untouched. Matching uses only the order's
        # current shipment object, never historical snapshots, and the
        # expected delivery's normalized recipient/delivered_on must match
        # every selected order's current delivery before anything is revoked.
        # Shipped matches and every other status are not selected. Status
        # reverts to shipped; lines, amounts, shipment, stock, reservations,
        # carts and existing returns are never touched, returns never block a
        # revoke, and no stock events are added.
        carrier = text(carrier, "carrier")
        tracking_no = text(tracking_no, "tracking_no")
        expected = self._delivery_info(expected_delivery, "expected_delivery")
        data = self._read()
        matched = []
        for order in data.get("orders", {}).values():
            # Only delivered orders are selected; shipped and every other
            # status never are, even when their shipment matches.
            if order.get("status") != "delivered":
                continue
            shipment = order.get("shipment")
            # A missing or non-object shipment, or one whose required fields
            # are missing, non-string or blank, simply cannot match.
            if not isinstance(shipment, dict):
                continue
            current_carrier = shipment.get("carrier")
            current_tracking = shipment.get("tracking_no")
            if not isinstance(current_carrier, str) or not isinstance(current_tracking, str):
                continue
            if current_carrier.strip() != carrier or current_tracking.strip() != tracking_no:
                continue
            matched.append(order)
        if not matched:
            raise ValueError("no delivered orders match this shipment")
        matched.sort(key=lambda order: order["order_id"])
        # Check every selected order's current delivery against the expected
        # delivery before mutating anything, so a missing, conflicting or
        # malformed stored delivery leaves the file, sequences and every
        # order untouched. Revoking always changes the order, so there is no
        # no-op case: a later repeat finds no selected order and is rejected.
        for order in matched:
            current = self._delivery_info(order.get("delivery"), "delivery")
            if expected != current:
                raise ValueError("expected delivery does not match current delivery: " + order["order_id"])
        for order in matched:
            order["status"] = "shipped"
            order.pop("delivery", None)
            self._record_event(data, order["order_id"], "revoke-delivery", order, False)
        self._write(data)
        return {"carrier": carrier, "tracking_no": tracking_no, "orders": matched}

    def pick_list(self, order_ids):
        # Read-only picking summary across the selected placed orders: it merges
        # quantities by sku while keeping per-order demand and reservation
        # detail. It never writes, never fabricates reservations for orders
        # placed before a product became managed, and never counts reservations
        # held by orders outside the selection.
        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
        selected = []
        seen = set()
        for order_id in order_ids:
            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
            if order_id in seen:
                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
            seen.add(order_id)
            selected.append(order_id)
        data = self._read()
        orders = data.get("orders", {})
        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole query is
        # rejected if any selected order is missing or no longer placed.
        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
        for order_id in selected:
            order = orders.get(order_id)
            if order is None:
                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
            if order["status"] != "placed":
                raise ValueError("only a placed order can be picked: " + order_id)
            per_order = {}
            for line in order["lines"]:
                per_order[line["sku"]] = per_order.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
            demanded[order_id] = per_order
        skus = set()
        for per_order in demanded.values():
            skus.update(per_order)
        lines = []
        for sku in sorted(skus):
            quantity = 0
            reserved = 0
            order_rows = []
            for order_id in sorted(demanded):
                per_order = demanded[order_id]
                if sku not in per_order:
                    continue
                order_quantity = per_order[sku]
                quantity += order_quantity
                order_reserved = all_reservations.get(order_id, {}).get(sku, 0)
                reserved += order_reserved
                order_rows.append({
                    "order_id": order_id,
                    "quantity": order_quantity,
                    "reserved": order_reserved,
                })
            entry = inventory.get(sku)
            if entry is None:
                # Legacy data without an inventory record stays unmanaged: no
                # availability, no reservations and no shortfall.
                available = None
                reserved = 0
                shortfall = 0
                for row in order_rows:
                    row["reserved"] = 0
            else:
                available = entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]
                shortfall = max(0, quantity - reserved - available)
            lines.append({
                "sku": sku,
                "quantity": quantity,
                "reserved": reserved,
                "available": available,
                "shortfall": shortfall,
                "orders": order_rows,
            })
        return {"order_ids": sorted(selected), "lines": lines}

    def reservation_plan(self, order_ids):
        # Read-only priority preview of reservation top-ups: orders are previewed
        # in the given order; an order whose new demand fits the remaining margin
        # consumes that margin, a short order consumes nothing and later orders
        # keep being evaluated. Existing reservations are never released or
        # transferred; this never writes.
        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
        selected = []
        seen = set()
        for order_id in order_ids:
            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
            if order_id in seen:
                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
            seen.add(order_id)
            selected.append(order_id)
        data = self._read()
        orders = data.get("orders", {})
        products = data.get("products", {})
        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole query is
        # rejected if any selected order is missing, no longer placed, or carries
        # a product outside the current catalog.
        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
        for order_id in selected:

        # only reduced by earlier orders that could be completed.

        for sku, entry in inventory.items():

        results = []
        for order_id in selected:

    def reservation_audit(self, sku):
        # Read-only per-product reconciliation: the stock view's reserved total
        # versus the reservations actually held by the placed orders whose
        # current lines contain the sku. It never writes, never fabricates
        # reservations from deal content or history, and never corrects a
        # mismatch -- a legacy gap is reported as the actual difference.
        sku = text(sku, "sku")
        data = self._read()
        if sku not in data.get("products", {}):
            raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
        # Reuse the stock query itself so the embedded view is always identical
        # to a standalone stock call, including the unmanaged null semantics.
        stock = self.stock(sku)
        managed = sku in data.get("inventory", {})
        rows = []
        allocated = 0
        for order in data.get("orders", {}).values():
            if order["status"] != "placed":
                continue
            quantity = 0
            for line in order["lines"]:
                if line["sku"] == sku:
                    quantity += line["quantity"]
            if not quantity:
                continue
            order_id = order["order_id"]
            if managed:
                reserved = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {}).get(sku, 0)
            else:
                # Unmanaged products (including legacy data without inventory
                # records) hold no reservations, regardless of stray records.
                reserved = 0
            rows.append({
                "order_id": order_id,
                "quantity": quantity,
                "reserved": reserved,
                "unreserved": max(0, quantity - reserved),
            })
            allocated += reserved
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["order_id"])
        # Keep the sign: positive means stock holds reservations not detailed
        # by the displayed orders, negative means the details exceed the books.
        return {
            "stock": stock,
            "allocated": allocated,
            "difference": stock["reserved"] - allocated,
            "orders": rows,
        }

    def list_orders(self):
        return sorted(self._read().get("orders", {}).values(), key=lambda x: x["order_id"])

    def quote_return(self, order_id, lines):
        # Read-only return preview: amounts come from the order's stored deal
        # prices, never the catalog, and paused sales, missing stock, unmanaged
        # or catalog-less products never block original-order items. It never
        # writes, never creates the data directory, never occupies return
        # allowance, and a later record_return still validates against the
        # data current at that time.
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        requested, _ = self._merged_return_lines(lines, "lines")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
            raise ValueError("only a shipped or delivered order can quote a return")
        ordered = {}
        deal_prices = {}
        for line in order["lines"]:
            sku = line["sku"]
            ordered[sku] = ordered.get(sku, 0) + line["quantity"]
            deal_prices.setdefault(sku, []).append(line.get("unit_price_cents"))
        # Active registrations occupy allowance, received ones included;
        # cancelled records free it and amended records count at their latest
        # quantities. Legacy data without any returns reads as nothing
        # returned and is never backfilled.
        returned = {}
        for record in data.get("returns", {}).get(order_id, []):
            for line in record["lines"]:
                returned[line["sku"]] = returned.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
        result_lines = []
        can_record = True
        for sku in sorted(requested):
            if sku not in ordered:
                raise ValueError("sku not in original order: " + sku)
            prices = deal_prices[sku]
            unit_price = prices[0]
            if type(unit_price) is not int or unit_price < 0:
                raise ValueError("stored unit price is missing or invalid: " + sku)
            if any(price != unit_price for price in prices):
                raise ValueError("inconsistent unit prices in order: " + sku)
            quantity = requested[sku]
            remaining = ordered[sku] - returned.get(sku, 0)
            if quantity > remaining:
                # Over-quantity is reported, not truncated: the full requested
                # amount is still priced.
                can_record = False
            result_lines.append({
                "sku": sku,
                "quantity": quantity,
                "unit_price_cents": unit_price,
                "subtotal_cents": quantity * unit_price,
                "remaining": remaining,
            })
        return {
            "order_id": order_id,
            "lines": result_lines,
            "total_cents": sum(line["subtotal_cents"] for line in result_lines),
            "can_record": can_record,

    def record_return(self, order_id, return_id, lines):
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        return_id = text(return_id, "return_id")

            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")

        for line in lines:
            if not isinstance(line, dict):

            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        if order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
            raise ValueError("only a shipped order can accept returns")

        # Cancelled returns leave the active records but keep their id occupied
        # for the whole root: a return_id can never be registered again, not
        # even against a different order.
        for bucket in (all_returns, data.get("cancelled_returns", {})):
            for records in bucket.values():

                    if record["return_id"] == return_id:

        ordered = {}
        for line in order["lines"]:
            ordered[line["sku"]] = ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
        returned = {}
        for record in all_returns.get(order_id, []):
            for line in record["lines"]:
                returned[line["sku"]] = returned.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
            if sku not in ordered:
                raise ValueError("sku not in original order: " + sku)
            if returned.get(sku, 0) + quantity > ordered[sku]:
                raise ValueError("returned quantity exceeds ordered quantity: " + sku)

            "order_id": order_id,
            "return_id": return_id,

        self._record_event(data, order_id, "record-return", record, False)
        self._write(data)
        return record

    def get_returns(self, order_id):
        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
        data = self._read()
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
        records = sorted(data.get("returns", {}).get(order_id, []), key=lambda x: x["return_id"])
        ordered = {}
        for line in order["lines"]:
            ordered[line["sku"]] = ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
        returned = {}
        for record in records:
            for line in record["lines"]:
                returned[line["sku"]] = returned.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]

    def cancel_return(self, return_id):
        # Whole-registration cancellation only: it frees returnable quantity
        # (the record stops counting in remaining) but never touches stock,
        # reservations, order status, amounts, lines or shipment. The return_id
        # stays occupied for the whole root.
        return_id = text(return_id, "return_id")
        data = self._read()
        located = self._find_return(data, return_id)
        if located is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown return: " + return_id)
        order_id, record, cancelled = located
        if cancelled:
            raise ValueError("return already cancelled: " + return_id)
        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None or order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
            raise ValueError("only a shipped order can cancel a return: " + order_id)
        if return_id in data.get("return_receipts", {}):
            raise ValueError("return already received: " + return_id)
        # Build the success snapshot before mutating; lines are already merged
        # by sku and sorted from record_return, but copy only sku/quantity so
        # the result never carries extra fields.
        result = {
            "order_id": order_id,
            "return_id": return_id,
            "lines": [{"sku": line["sku"], "quantity": line["quantity"]} for line in record["lines"]],
        }
        records = data["returns"][order_id]
        records.remove(record)
        if not records:
            del data["returns"][order_id]
        data.setdefault("cancelled_returns", {}).setdefault(order_id, []).append(copy.deepcopy(record))
        self._record_event(data, order_id, "cancel-return", result, False)
        self._write(data)
        return result

    def _find_return(self, data, return_id):
        # Returns (order_id, record, cancelled) for both active and cancelled
        # registrations, so callers can tell an occupied-but-cancelled id from
        # an unknown one.
        for records in data.get("returns", {}).values():
            for record in records:
                if record["return_id"] == return_id:
                    return record["order_id"], record, False
        for records in data.get("cancelled_returns", {}).values():
            for record in records:
                if record["return_id"] == return_id:
                    return record["order_id"], record, True
        return None

    def _merged_return_lines(value, label):
        # Normalizes a return line list: a nonempty list of objects each with a
        # trimmed nonempty sku and a positive integer quantity (booleans
        # rejected); extra fields are ignored and duplicate skus merge. Returns
        # (merged, lines) where merged maps sku -> quantity and lines is the
        # sorted sku/quantity list used for comparison, storage and results.
        if not isinstance(value, list) or not value:
            raise ValueError(label + " must be a nonempty list")
        merged = {}
        for line in value:
            if not isinstance(line, dict):
                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
            merged[sku] = merged.get(sku, 0) + quantity
        return merged, [{"sku": sku, "quantity": merged[sku]} for sku in sorted(merged)]

        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
        if order is None or order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
            raise ValueError("only a shipped order can amend a return: " + order_id)
        if return_id in data.get("return_receipts", {}):

2446	    def cancel_received_return(self, return_id):
2447	        # Whole-reversal of an already received return: every product's current
2448	        # on_hand is reduced by the quantity the original receipt added, so
2449	        # restocks, shipments and stock counts after the receive are preserved.
2450	        # Available drops by the same amount; reserved and every order's
2451	        # reservation records are never touched. The registration becomes
2452	        # cancelled (freeing returnable quantity) but its id stays occupied
2453	        # for the whole root, the original receipt stays queryable, and order
2454	        # status, deal lines, amounts, shipment and delivery are preserved.
2455	        # Paused sales never block the reversal; no refund happens.
2456	        return_id = text(return_id, "return_id")
2457	        data = self._read()
2458	        located = self._find_return(data, return_id)
2459	        if located is None:
2460	            raise ValueError("unknown return: " + return_id)
2461	        order_id, record, cancelled = located
2462	        if cancelled:
2463	            raise ValueError("return already cancelled: " + return_id)
2464	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
2465	        if order is None or order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
2466	            raise ValueError("only a shipped order can cancel a received return: " + order_id)
2467	        receipt = data.get("return_receipts", {}).get(return_id)
2468	        if receipt is None:
2469	            # Legacy registrations without a receipt read as not received.
2470	            raise ValueError("return has not been received: " + return_id)
2471	        products = data.get("products", {})
2472	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
2473	        quantities = {}
2474	        for line in receipt["lines"]:
2475	            quantities[line["sku"]] = quantities.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2476	        # Validate every product and every resulting on_hand against the
2477	        # current stock before touching any inventory entry, so a rejected
2478	        # reversal leaves stock, returns, receipts, history and sequences
2479	        # untouched and never creates the data directory.
2480	        result_lines = []
2481	        for sku in sorted(quantities):
2482	            if sku not in products:
2483	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
2484	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
2485	            if entry is None:
2486	                raise ValueError("product is not managed: " + sku)
2487	            quantity = quantities[sku]
2488	            on_hand = entry["on_hand"] - quantity
2489	            if on_hand < 0:
2490	                raise ValueError("reversed on_hand cannot be negative: " + sku)
2491	            reserved = entry["reserved"]
2492	            if on_hand < reserved:
2493	                raise ValueError("reversed on_hand cannot be below reserved quantity: " + sku)
2494	            result_lines.append({
2495	                "sku": sku,
2496	                "quantity": quantity,
2497	                "before": self._stock_view(sku, entry),
2498	                "after": {"sku": sku, "on_hand": on_hand, "reserved": reserved, "available": on_hand - reserved},
2499	            })
2500	        for line in result_lines:
2501	            inventory[line["sku"]]["on_hand"] = line["after"]["on_hand"]
2502	            self._record_stock_event(
2503	                data, line["sku"], "cancel-received-return", return_id, line["before"], line["after"]
2504	            )
2505	        result = {"order_id": order_id, "return_id": return_id, "lines": result_lines}
2506	        records = data["returns"][order_id]
2507	        records.remove(record)
2508	        if not records:
2509	            del data["returns"][order_id]
2510	        data.setdefault("cancelled_returns", {}).setdefault(order_id, []).append(copy.deepcopy(record))
2511	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "cancel-received-return", result, False)
2512	        self._write(data)
2513	        return result

2515	    def return_worklist(self, stage="pending", order_id=None):
2516	        # Read-only cross-order worklist: active registrations read as pending
2517	        # unless they hold a receipt (received), cancelled registrations read as
2518	        # cancelled but stay visible. It never writes, never fabricates
2519	        # registrations from history, and treats missing receipts or cancellation
2520	        # buckets simply as absent.
2521	        if not isinstance(stage, str):
2522	            raise ValueError("stage must be one of: pending, received, cancelled, all")
2523	        stage = stage.strip()
2524	        if stage not in ("pending", "received", "cancelled", "all"):
2525	            raise ValueError("stage must be one of: pending, received, cancelled, all")
2526	        if order_id is not None:
2527	            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
2528	        data = self._read()
2529	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
2530	        if order_id is not None and order_id not in orders:
2531	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
2532	        receipts = data.get("return_receipts", {})
2533	        # Collect (record, record_stage) pairs in scope. Active records come
2534	        # first, cancelled ones after; the final result is sorted by return_id.
2535	        scoped = []
2536	        for bucket, is_cancelled in (
2537	            (data.get("returns", {}), False),
2538	            (data.get("cancelled_returns", {}), True),
2539	        ):
2540	            keys = (order_id,) if order_id is not None else sorted(bucket)
2541	            for key in keys:
2542	                for record in bucket.get(key, ()):
2543	                    if is_cancelled:
2544	                        record_stage = "cancelled"
2545	                    elif record["return_id"] in receipts:
2546	                        record_stage = "received"
2547	                    else:
2548	                        record_stage = "pending"
2549	                    if stage == "all" or record_stage == stage:
2550	                        scoped.append((record, record_stage))
2551	        # Every registration the worklist would actually contain must still
2552	        # belong to an existing shipped order; validate before building any view
2553	        # so one bad legacy record rejects the whole query instead of surfacing
2554	        # partial results.
2555	        for record, _ in scoped:
2556	            order = orders.get(record["order_id"])
2557	            if order is None:
2558	                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + record["order_id"])
2559	            if order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
2560	                raise ValueError("only a shipped order can be on the return worklist: " + record["order_id"])
2561	        products = data.get("products", {})
2562	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
2563	        entries = []
2564	        for record, record_stage in scoped:
2565	            quantities = {}
2566	            for line in record["lines"]:
2567	                quantities[line["sku"]] = quantities.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2568	            lines = [{"sku": sku, "quantity": quantities[sku]} for sku in sorted(quantities)]
2569	            blockers = []
2570	            if record_stage == "pending":
2571	                # Only pending entries are checked against the current catalog
2572	                # and inventory; paused sales never block receiving.
2573	                for sku in sorted(quantities):
2574	                    if sku not in products:
2575	                        blockers.append({"sku": sku, "reason": "unknown-product"})
2576	                    elif sku not in inventory:
2577	                        blockers.append({"sku": sku, "reason": "unmanaged"})
2578	            entries.append({
2579	                "order_id": record["order_id"],
2580	                "return_id": record["return_id"],
2581	                "stage": record_stage,
2582	                "lines": lines,
2583	                "can_receive": record_stage == "pending" and not blockers,
2584	                "blockers": blockers,
2585	            })
2586	        entries.sort(key=lambda item: item["return_id"])
2587	        return entries
